g.text: El Dorado: restore the illustrated woodland patches
Original canopy outlines informed by the official map; no measured canon boundary,tree species or initial-era survey.
4788 biome cells change inside the two new forest outlines; height,water and road exports remain identical.
City,volcano,lake,all58 sites and22 roads stay fixed. Exact canopy extent and forest biome are server interpretation.
Official illustration is linked in the review;copyrighted source pixels are excluded from this repository artifact.
